newsitem.title: USA: High US capacity has room for growth - Chicago Fed.
newsitem.headline: High US capacity has room for growth - Chicago Fed.

text.p: The U.S. manufacturing sector, although already operating at high capacity levels, has room to further expand at a sustainable pace, a senior economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said on Wednesday.

"Manufacturing will be able to expand at a nice, a solid, sustainable pace," Robert Schnorbus, senior economist at the Chicago Fed, told RFTV, Reuters' financial television network, in an exclusive interview.
"What's driving manufacturing is orders and backlogs, and right now, they are in pretty good shape," Schnorbus noted.
